description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the loan product features related to credit allocations in the Apache Fineract project. It defines test cases for creating, updating, and deleting loan products with various credit allocation configurations, and validates related behaviors and constraints.

classes.name: LoanProductWithCreditAllocationsIntegrationTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating creation, modification, and deletion of loan products with credit allocations in Fineract.

methods.name: setupTests
methods.description: Initializes test setup, including REST assured configuration and account creation.

methods.name: testCreateAndReadLoanProductWithAdvancedPaymentAndCreditAllocations
methods.description: Tests creating a loan product with advanced payment and credit allocations, then verifies retrieval.

methods.name: testCreateLoanProductAndLaterAddCreditAllocation
methods.description: Creates a loan product, then updates it to add a credit allocation and verifies the update.

methods.name: testCreateAndUpdateCreditAllocation
methods.description: Creates a loan product with credit allocations, then updates the credit allocation order and verifies.

methods.name: testCreateAndDeleteCreditAllocation
methods.description: Creates a loan product with credit allocations, then removes the credit allocations and verifies.

methods.name: testCreditAllocationIsNotAllowedWhenPaymentStrategyIsNotAdvancedPaymentStrategy
methods.description: Verifies that credit allocations are not allowed when the payment strategy is not 'advanced'.

methods.name: testCreateLoanProductWithCreditAllocationThenUpdatePaymentStrategyShouldFail
methods.description: Ensures updating a loan product with credit allocation to a non-allowed payment strategy fails.

methods.name: createChargebackAllocation
methods.description: Helper to create a credit allocation with a CHARGEBACK transaction type.

methods.name: createCreditAllocationOrders
methods.description: Helper to generate ordered credit allocation rules.

methods.name: baseLoanProduct
methods.description: Builds a base loan product configuration for tests.

methods.name: updateLoanProductRequest
methods.description: Creates request objects to update loan product credit allocations.

methods.name: updateLoanProductRequest (overloaded)
methods.description: Creates request objects to update the transaction processing strategy.

methods.name: createRepaymentPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Builds an advanced payment data object configured for repayment allocation.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Builds a default advanced payment data object.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationOrder
methods.description: Creates a list of payment allocation orders based on given payment types.

methods.name: setProperFinancialActivity
methods.description: Configures the financial activity accounts for asset transfer.
